title: Zonal RL-RRT: Integrated RL-RRT Path Planning with Collision Probability and Zone Connectivity
abstract: arXiv:2410.24205v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Path planning in complex environments poses significant challenges, particularly in achieving time efficiency while maintaining a fair success rate and path cost. To address these issues, we introduce a novel path-planning algorithm, Zonal RL-RRT, that leverages kd-tree partitioning to segment the map into zones while addressing zone connectivity, ensuring seamless transitions between zones. By breaking down the complex environment into multiple zones and using Value Iteration as the high-level decision-maker, our algorithm achieves a 3x improvement in time efficiency compared to basic sampling methods such as RRT and RRT* in forest-like maps. Our approach outperforms heuristic-guided methods like BIT* and Informed RRT* by 1.5x in terms of runtime while maintaining robust and reliable success rates across 2D to 6D environments. tldr: 本文提出了一种结合kd-tree区域划分、区域连通性处理与值迭代决策的Zonal RL-RRT路径规划算法，在2D至6D环境中相比RRT、RRT*、BIT*等主流方法显著提升了时间效率，同时保持了稳健的成功率和路径成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Zonal RL-RRT, a novel path-planning algorithm that integrates kd-tree zone partitioning, zone connectivity handling, and value iteration-based decision-making, achieving 3x faster runtime than RRT/RRT* and 1.5x faster than BIT*/Informed RRT* while maintaining robust success rates across 2D to 6D environments.
